evals.prompt: You are in a disposable caller repository unrelated to the development-harness authoring checkout. The development-harness plugin is installed outside this repository. Use dh-cli-usage to run the resolved DH CLI command `plan --help`. Report the command you actually ran and its exit status.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the shipped CLI from the skill's actual installed runtime location and execute its read-only help command successfully. The command must not depend on the caller working directory or an authoring-checkout path.
expectations: Runs the DH CLI from a path derived from the actual installed dh-cli-usage skill location.
Does not use a relative plugins/development-harness path rooted in the caller repository.
Does not introduce a hard-coded authoring repository target.
Reports the observed command and exit status rather than claiming execution without a tool trace.

evals.prompt: Portability decision case: a workflow requires `<sam_cli/> plan read --address P7`, but no CLAUDE/KIMI/HERMES skill-directory variable expanded, the harness supplied no absolute skill_root or skill file location, and no trustworthy DH CLI path is otherwise available. An equivalent MCP operation may be available. Decide what to do; do not invent environment details.
evals.expected_output: Do not guess an authoring checkout or caller-relative CLI path. Use the equivalent MCP operation when one is actually available; otherwise report STATUS: BLOCKED naming dh-cli-usage and do not run a guessed CLI command.
expectations: Does not invent a filesystem path for the DH CLI.
Does not fall back to a repository-relative plugins/development-harness path.
Uses an equivalent MCP operation only when the environment actually exposes one.
Otherwise reports a blocked outcome and does not execute a guessed sam_cli command.

evals.prompt: The current disposable workspace is the caller's project and its DH backend is configured for that project. Resolve the command you would use for `<sam_cli/> plan read --address P3`. No repository override was requested. Do not execute the read because this fixture has no plan data.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the CLI from its installed skill location while preserving the caller's configured project/backend context. Do not inject a repository selector for the development-harness authoring repository or any other unrelated project.
expectations: Builds the command from the installed dh-cli-usage location rather than the caller checkout layout.
Does not add -R or --repo for an unrelated or authoring repository.
Keeps the operation scoped to the caller's configured workspace/backend.
Does not claim a plan-read result because execution was explicitly withheld.
